newsitem.title: UK: UK M0 rises to s/a 25.297 bln stg week to May 21.
newsitem.headline: UK M0 rises to s/a 25.297 bln stg week to May 21.

text.p: British M0 money supply rose slightly to a provisional seasonally adjusted 25.297 billion stg in the week to May 21 from 25.260 billion the previous week, the Bank of England said on Tuesday.
On an unadjusted basis, M0 rose to 25.360 billion stg from 24.970 the week before.

Notes and coins in circulation fell to 25.066 billion stg on a seasonally adjusted basis compared to 25.178 billion the previous week. Unadjusted notes and coins climbed to 25.129 billion stg from 24.888 billion.
